title: Quiz End to End Fault Tolerance
description: Get quiz working end to end and thoroughly tested, with and without a connection to the proctor; the proctor must be able to go offline at any time (completely fault tolerant). Fix the reported runtime crashes: QuizSession.rehint reading 'hints' of undefined (from loadRun), RunScreen keysHidden reading 'keys' of undefined, and presence WebSocket noise ('WebSocket is closed before the connection is established').
note: Ticket bookkeeping manual on disk: repo MCP ticket_open and ticket_close returned a malformed result (structuredContent null) on 2026-10-03 and changed nothing. Closed manually on 2026-10-03.
summary: The quiz works end to end with and without its proctor, and with a proctor of another build. The reported crashes came from a stale dev proctor (from before the challenge levels) and a client that both spoke wire version 1. The contract gained $defs/WireVersion (2) with TS and Rust twins, used by the proctor and the client; the new language-agnostic case 🤝️wire-version pins the schema's fingerprint to it. ProctorClient agrees with the proctor through GET /instance: an incompatible proctor is sent nothing and counts as away (transient: the outbox keeps waiting, the deputy decides, a recheck every 30 s). Views are shape-checked and unreadable answers are shortages. UI: an out-of-date banner with reload, a ScreenBoundary per screen, presence sockets closed only once open. The dev stack supervises its proctor (rebuild on a Rust change, relaunch on a catalog change or crash, a warning for a reused proctor of another contract), and semioServeUpgradeVitePlugin keeps the dev server alive under Bun 1.3 when the proctor goes away. Fixed the collapsed home cards (display:contents host) that kept 🥞️layered-home red. New e2e spec 🛟️proctor-faults. Gates: React 839/839, core TS 415, Rust 177, parity 132/132, proctor 90+15+21, site 234/234, typecheck clean; e2e all projects green in both topologies except 🐕️pet-walk, which assumed the collapsed card geometry and is being adapted by the active QUIZ-PETS session (informed, accepted). See 📓️report.md.
